scripts.translation: 我们必须尽力做好工作，否则我们就会立刻丧命。

scripts.text: But, now, we are losing our place to the lifeless machines.
scripts.translation: 但现在，我们正在被这些没有生命的机器取代。

scripts.text: Many people have quit this job after the machines were introduced.
scripts.translation: 自从引入这些机器后，许多人已经辞去了这份工作。

scripts.text: I must admit that I am also being shaken by the thought.
scripts.translation: 我必须承认，我也被这种想法动摇了。

scripts.text: Bah, god damn you, Rekenber! You just have created the worst invention in history!
scripts.translation: 该死，该死的雷根贝勒！你创造了历史上最糟糕的发明！

scripts.text: Damn it! Finally it happened today!
Today, our troops was in total disorder.

scripts.text: One of the guardians caused an error and brought havoc.
scripts.translation: 我们的部队陷入了彻底的混乱。

scripts.text: While we were terrified and didn't know what to do, that broken guardian

scripts.text: I can't remember how we could regain control over the broken guardian.
scripts.translation: 我不记得我们是如何重新控制那台故障的守卫的。

scripts.text: My mind is still baffled for the fact that that machine actually killed an innocent guy as I was kind of worried about.
scripts.translation: 我的大脑仍然因那台机器真的杀死了一个无辜的人而感到困惑，

scripts.text: Many people were dispatched from Rekenber to investigate this matter, so hopefully they will figure out
scripts.translation: 正如我之前担心的那样。雷根贝勒派了许多人来调查此事，

scripts.text: what the hell was wrong with that machine.
scripts.translation: 希望他们能弄清楚那台机器到底出了什么问题。

scripts.text: But, it is not going to change the fact that one of our comrade was taken his life by that merciless machine,
scripts.translation: 但这并不能改变一个事实：我们的一个同伴被那台无情的机器夺去了生命，

scripts.text: and no once can replace his place for his family.
scripts.translation: 而且没有人能代替他在家人心中的位置。

scripts.text: We received a message from upper management.
scripts.translation: **月 **日我们收到了来自上级的消息。

scripts.text: "^3131FFKeep our mouth from spreading the story to outside.^000000", that's the content of message.
Rekenber must have bribed the upper management of our troops with money.
Otherwise, why would they want us to keep our mouth sealed about a such shocking incident?
scripts.translation: 雷根贝勒一定用金钱收买了我们部队的高层。否则，他们为什么要我们对如此震惊的事件守口如瓶？

scripts.text: We, angry mercenary soldiers burst into rage right after the morning session was over.
scripts.translation: 我们愤怒的佣兵在早会后立刻爆发了。

scripts.text: We went ahead and spread the story about the shocking incident to every mercenary troops.
scripts.translation: 随后，我们把这一震惊事件传给了每支佣兵部队。

scripts.text: And then we destroyed every guardian which we found in hangars.
scripts.translation: 然后我们摧毁了在机库中发现的每一台守卫。

scripts.text: The sounds of hammering metal and sirens were echoing everywhere, everywhere you went.
scripts.translation: 金属敲击声和警报声到处回荡，无论你去哪里都能听到。

scripts.text: ...We took refuge in a safe place out of our unit because of what happened.
scripts.translation: ...由于发生的事，我们躲在单位外的一个安全地方。

scripts.text: We are planning to assert our social security to the public and inform the public with
scripts.translation: 我们计划向公众主张我们的社会保障，

scripts.text: the danger of the guardians and the negligence of the government and Rekenber toward the incident.
scripts.translation: 并告知公众守卫的危险以及政府和雷根贝勒对这一事件的疏忽。

scripts.text: Our leader told us that he has sent out letters to every mercenary troop
scripts.translation: 我们的首领告诉我们，他已向每个佣兵部队发出信件，

scripts.text: to encourage them to participate in what we are trying to do.
scripts.translation: 鼓励他们参与我们正在做的事情。 我觉得.

scripts.text: I feel like...that I have just turn into a no-way-out.
I am facing my future with a deep sense of gloom.
scripts.translation: 我带着深深的绝望面对着我的未来。

scripts.text: ^3131FF...I am so sorry for hearing such devastating news and for your loss.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF...听到如此令人悲痛的消息和你们的损失，

scripts.text: Every member of our troops are already aware of the shocking incident,
scripts.translation: 我感到非常抱歉。我们部队的每个成员都已经知道了这一震惊事件，

scripts.text: and all of us are uncontrollably enraged.
scripts.translation: 我们所有人都愤怒得无法控制。
法控制。政府被雷根贝勒

scripts.text: with Rekenber's filthy money and has become nothing but a puppet.
scripts.translation: 政府被雷根贝勒肮脏的金钱收买，已经变成了一个傀儡。

scripts.text: We must take control over our life once again. Our future depends on us.
scripts.translation: 我们必须重新掌控我们的生活。我们的未来取决于我们自己。

scripts.text: We will join you, 'Blade Canine Mercenary' to fight for our rights.^000000
scripts.translation: 我们将加入你们，“刃犬佣兵”，为我们的权利而^000000战。

scripts.text: Our firm will was not enough.
scripts.translation: 我们的意志还不够坚定。

scripts.text: Our desperate effort was not enough!
Many mercenary groups joined us to fight with the government and Rekenber.
scripts.translation: 许多佣兵团加入我们，与政府和雷根贝勒作战。

scripts.text: But we were too weak to compete with their invincible guardians. We were literally swept away.
scripts.translation: 但我们太弱了，无法与他们无敌的守卫抗衡。我们被彻底击溃了。

scripts.text: They were quicker than we expected in taking action, and lines and lines of guardians were coming after us.
scripts.translation: 他们采取行动比我们预期的要快，一排排守卫追着我们。

scripts.text: There was nothing that we could do. We met with a disastrous defeat in the battle with guardians.
scripts.translation: 我们无能为力。在与守卫的战斗中，我们遭遇了惨败。

scripts.text: Everybody is still in shock, but we can't give up now.
scripts.translation: 于震惊中，但我们现在不能放弃。我

scripts.text: I think that we are going to visit a house of a sage called "Varmunt" early in the morning.
scripts.translation: 每个人仍然处于震惊中，但我们现在不能放弃。

scripts.text: I don't know why, but it seems that the sage is against the use of guardians.
scripts.translation: 我想我们明天一早要去拜访一位名叫“瓦尔蒙特”的贤者。

scripts.text: People say that his mansion is rather like a fortress.
scripts.translation: 我不知道为什么，但似乎这位贤者反对使用守卫。

scripts.text: I also don't know why someone would want to build his house
scripts.translation: 人们说他的宅邸更像是一座堡垒。

scripts.text: as strong as a fortress. Regardless, I am pretty sure that his support will be a great help for us.
scripts.translation: 我也不知为什么有人要把房子建得像堡垒一样坚固。无论如何，我相当确定他的支持将对我们有很大帮助。

scripts.text: It was a really tiring day today. It was also a very chaotic day.
scripts.translation: 今天真是累人的一天，也是非常混乱的一天。

scripts.text: To be honest, I don't know what is going to happen now.
scripts.translation: 老实说，我不知道接下来会发生什么。

scripts.text: I am scared if I would die helplessly. I am scared and depressed.
scripts.translation: 我害怕自己会无助地死去。我害怕，也很沮丧。

scripts.text: Why must this happen to us, and what have we done to deserve such a horrible treatment?
scripts.translation: 为什么这种事会发生在我们身上？我们做了什么，竟要遭受如此可怕的对待？

scripts.translation: 。我想政府决心通过这次事件消灭我们，

scripts.translation: 这些佣兵。人们现在开始对我们表现出怨恨，

scripts.text: This is not right. Something has went wrong. We just wanted the government to secure our lives, that was all.
scripts.translation: 因为我们给他们的国家带来了混乱。这不公平。某些事情出了错。我们只是希望政府保障我们的生活，

scripts.text: It has been a while since I wrote a journal last time.
scripts.translation: **月 **日自上次写日记以来已经过了一段时间。

scripts.text: I am in Hugel, a small town at the border of Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 我在毁葛，秀发兹发德共和国边境的一个小镇。

scripts.text: Because of the locational penalty, people of this town seldom see outsiders, and if they see one, they treate them warmheartedly.
scripts.translation: 由于地理位置的劣势，这个镇子的人很少见到外人，如果见到一个，他们会热情地对待他们。

scripts.text: Although I didn't have a time to write a journal that time, the last fight in the Varmunt mansion turned out to be our miserable defeat...as I was worried.
scripts.translation: 虽然当时我没有时间写日记，但瓦尔蒙特宅邸的最后一战结果如我所担心的那样，是我们悲惨的失败.

scripts.text: I was told that Sage Varmunt disappeared after the fight, and all of his documents were taken by Rekenber.
scripts.translation: ..我听说贤者瓦尔蒙特在战斗后失踪了，他所有的文件都被雷根贝勒拿走了。

scripts.text: I am afraid that they might create a more powerful version of the existing guardian by using his documents.
scripts.translation: 我担心他们可能会利用他的文件制造出比现有守卫更强大的版本。

scripts.text: I lost one arm during the last fight, and I barely escaped to Hugel.
scripts.translation: 我在最后一战中失去了一只手臂，勉强逃到了毁葛。

scripts.text: I feel so lucky to be in Hugel, because when I arrived, I was a total mess with only one arm,
scripts.translation: 我觉得很幸运能在毁葛，因为当我到达时，我只有一只手臂，浑身是伤，

scripts.text: but the people in this town did not ask me anything but welcomed me.
scripts.translation: 但这个镇子的人没有问我任何问题，而是欢迎了我。

scripts.text: I have nowhere to go any longer. I am planning to live my life here as long as nothing happens soon.
scripts.translation: 我再也没有地方可去了。我计划在这里生活，只要很快没有事情发生。

scripts.text: My arm is throbbing with pain again. The history of mercenary soldiers ended, and I need to rest.
scripts.translation: 我的手臂又开始疼痛了。佣兵的历史结束了，我需要休息。

scripts.text: I hope that this will be the last page of my journal.
scripts.translation: 我希望这将是我日记的最后一页。
